description: This file defines an abstract base class for Akka HTTP routes within the Eclipse Ditto gateway services. It handles request processing, timeout management, response transformation, supervision strategy, and related utility functions for route classes, and manages external dependencies such as actor references, HTTP configurations, and header translation.

classes.name: AbstractRoute
classes.description: An abstract base class for defining HTTP routes within the Eclipse Ditto gateway, handling request processing, supervision, response transformation, and configuration management.

methods.name: handlePerRequest
methods.description: Handles an incoming HTTP request by executing the given command, managing timeouts, and processing the response, including optional transformation of the JSON response body.

methods.name: doHandlePerRequest
methods.description: Internal method to perform the request handling, creating an actor to process the command and optionally transforming the response.

methods.name: preprocessResponse
methods.description: Provides a hook to modify or process the HTTP response before it is sent back to the client; default implementation returns the response unchanged.

methods.name: createHttpPerRequestActor
methods.description: Creates an Akka actor for handling the HTTP request using dynamically loaded props.

methods.name: ensureMediaTypeJsonWithFallbacksThenExtractDataBytes
methods.description: Ensures the media type of the request is JSON or a fallback type and extracts the data bytes for further processing.

methods.name: withCustomRequestTimeout
methods.description: Wraps a route with a custom request timeout, validating and adjusting the timeout as needed.

methods.name: increaseHttpRequestTimeout
methods.description: Increases the request timeout to account for potential race conditions, using either milliseconds or Scala duration.

methods.name: validateCommandTimeout
methods.description: Validates that a command timeout is within the maximum allowed range; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: calculateSelectedFields
methods.description: Static utility to parse and compute an optional JsonFieldSelector from a string of fields.

methods.name: throttleByConfig
methods.description: Creates a flow to throttle stream processing based on a given ThrottlingConfig.
